About Directed Edge
Directed Edge focuses on e-commerce recommendations within the digital retail sector. The company offers a Shopify plugin that includes related products, shopping cart suggestions, product bundles, personalized recommendations for returning customers, and integration of recommendations into transactional emails.
Directed Edge serves the e-commerce industry with tailored product suggestions. It was founded in 2009 and is based in San Francisco, California.
